intro.text: A guard of the Ire who keeps watch on the roof of their fortress in the Cognitive Realm.

items.text: Was on watch on the fortress roof when Kelsier crept up to its wall. Though Kelsier had learned to make himself nearly invisible, Maod spotted him, then lost him in the dark before he got inside.

Thought he might have seen a shade, though his captain doubted it. They reported it to Alonoe, whose device found no Threnodites nearby, since Kelsier was from Scadrial; the guards were still told to stay on high alert.
